title: Add Windows support for mem CLI
description: Deferred follow-up. Audit and, where practical, support Windows without changing the current CLI-first behavior. Check managed data/cache paths, file privacy semantics (Unix modes/umask versus Windows ACLs), staged migration directory durability sync, bundled SQLite/fastembed availability, Git/project detection, and add target CI or compile/runtime coverage. Do not begin until Windows support is an explicit product goal; current macOS dogfooding is not blocked.
